title: The Heterogeneous Local Pass: A Worked Pass Showing the Divergence of Arithmetic Retention & Multiplicative Coherence
source_native_claims: Shows, on one small object (three local channels under a frozen linear embedding), that arithmetic retention and multiplicative coherence are related but not identical, and that a healthy arithmetic surface can conceal a real multiplicative wound.
Does not introduce a new closure family, does not claim finite return, and does not stage a welded seam.
States that it prepares the reader for the next public burdens of the corpus: finite return, seam accounting, and welded continuity.
